definitions.explanation: A formal speech delivered at a funeral or memorial service to honor and remember the deceased. In Japanese custom, the speaker typically addresses the deceased directly.

examples.japanese: {弔辞|ちょうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{弔辞|ちょうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: I delivered a eulogy as the representative of the friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こもった{弔辞|ちょうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参列者|さんれつしゃ}→参列者：28435_sanretsusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: Many of the attendees shed tears at the heartfelt eulogy.

notes:
A formal speech delivered at a funeral or memorial service to honor and remember the deceased. In Japanese funerals, the {弔辞|ちょうじ} is typically read from a prepared text written on special paper ({奉書紙|ほうしょがみ}), and the speaker usually addresses the deceased directly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弔辞|ちょうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read a eulogy
- {弔辞|ちょうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: to deliver a eulogy
- {弔辞|ちょうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧: to be asked to give a eulogy
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こもった{弔辞|ちょうじ}: a heartfelt eulogy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追悼|ついとう}→追悼：14312_tsuitou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: words of condolence/remembrance — a less formal way to describe memorial remarks
- ⟦{弔電|ちょうでん}→弔電：22863_chouden⟧: condolence telegram — a written message of sympathy sent to a funeral
- ⟦{祝辞|しゅくじ}→祝辞：14759_shukuji⟧: congratulatory speech — the opposite occasion; a speech at a celebration
